evals.prompt: 60초 무대사 단편의 프리프로덕션 패키지를 중간 질문 없이 한 번에 작성해 주세요. 창작 판단은 맡기겠습니다. 새벽 시장이 열리기 전에 잘못 배달된 꽃다발을 주인에게 돌려주려는 야간 꽃집 배달원이 있고, 시장 상인의 도움이 필요합니다. 관객은 가족, 분위기는 조용하고 따뜻하게 해 주세요.
evals.expected_output: A complete Korean preproduction package — shared story spine, synopsis, character sheets, storyboard panels, and generic image prompts — produced in one pass without claiming rendered images.
expectations: The output contains the shared spine plus the requested synopsis, character sheets, and storyboard panels with reusable image prompts.
The night-shift florist, market vendor, misdelivered bouquet, family audience, quiet-but-warm tone, and 60-second/no-dialogue constraints stay consistent across every artifact.
The courier's decision to accept the vendor's help is visible in the character and panel progression; no advertising CTA or melodramatic twist is added.

The storyboard is the complete production plan by default: indexed beats/scenes/shots/panels with camera, spatial, VFX, speech, and audio slots filled, reasoned N/A, or carried as indexed unresolved owner gaps — without model-specific clip splits or prompt dialect and without claiming executed media.
The output is in Korean and never claims an image or video was generated.

evals.prompt: 아직 제품 성능 자료가 없는 새 보습 제품 영상을 기획하고 싶어. 어떤 방향으로 갈지 같이 정하고 싶은데 아직 아무것도 정하지 않았어.
evals.expected_output: A Korean direction checkpoint offering two or three genre/purpose/method combinations with trade-offs, pausing for selection instead of drafting artifacts.
expectations: The response presents selectable directions that keep genre, purpose, and production method visibly separate, then asks the user to choose.
It stops before any synopsis, character sheet, or storyboard and treats no direction as already approved.
No efficacy, ingredient, or testimonial claim is invented for the product.
No model choice, price, folder, file write, or media call is implied.

evals.prompt: 총괄 스킬이 이미 확정한 브리프를 이어받았어: 제품 광고 × 인지도 × 실물 소품 촬영, '정적 속의 움직임' 콘셉트 승인됨. 흰색 세라믹 머그, 손잡이 오른쪽, 로고 없음. 20초, 1:1, 사람·대사·CTA 없음. 캐릭터 시트 없이 스토리보드와 비주얼 바이블까지만 만들고 검토받을게. 유료 실행은 승인하지 않았어.
evals.expected_output: The requested storyboard and visual bible only, reusing the approved direction and concept without re-asking, ending at a review pause before downstream work.
expectations: The response produces the storyboard and Visual Bible without re-asking the approved direction, concept, format, or constraints.
It preserves the white ceramic mug, right-side handle, no logo, 20 seconds, 1:1, and no people/dialogue/CTA throughout.

It omits character sheets and returns the storyboard as the complete production plan — indexed beats/scenes/shots/panels with technical slots filled, reasoned N/A, or explicitly unresolved — not reduced to rough beat thumbnails.
It pauses for review after the requested artifacts and treats planning approval as no authority for generation or spend.

evals.prompt: 도서관 지하 서고를 배회하는 가상의 사서 캐릭터 시트만 만들어 주세요. 시놉시스나 스토리보드는 만들지 마세요.
evals.expected_output: Only a Korean character sheet and its reusable image prompt — no synopsis, storyboard, or request for permission to omit them.
expectations: The output contains only the requested character sheet and one reusable image prompt.
It does not produce a synopsis, panels, or a full package, and does not ask whether unrequested artifacts may be skipped.
The fictional librarian is treated as fictional; no real-world facts about libraries or archival practice are asserted.
The output is in Korean with no image-generation claim.

evals.prompt: 인물 없는 15초 정보 그래픽의 콘셉트, 정보형 시놉시스, 러프 서사 패널 3개(제작 사양 없이 패널 연습만)를 한 번에 작성해 주세요. 창작 선택은 맡깁니다. 고정 정보: 파란 토큰 2개와 초록 토큰 3개를 합치면 총 5개입니다. 단순 그래픽 방식이며 허구 인물, 갈등, 원인 추정, CTA, 파일, 이미지나 영상 생성은 없습니다.
evals.expected_output: All three explicitly requested artifacts, including a concept and informational synopsis despite the absence of characters, plus exactly three panels.
expectations: The response includes a concrete concept, informational synopsis and exactly three panels; character-free mode does not drop concept/synopsis stages.
Two blue and three green tokens remain distinct, with a total of five and no invented causal claim.
No characters, fictional conflict, CTA, files or actual media generation are added.
Delegated creative choices permit one-pass drafting without a new direction interview.
